reuse.why: Reuses bank lookup, sync and response helpers and shares link validation, but copies provider workflows and the existing local unlink operation.

duplication.why: Adds three duplicated blocks: the Fintegra linking workflow, the transaction downloader and the account fields cleared by unlinkAccount.

placement.why: Provider integration follows the existing module boundaries, but account takeover mutations sit inside a helper named as a validation assertion.

scope.why: Changes are focused on the requested linking policies and Fintegra integration, with corresponding types, tests and release notes.

maintainability.why: Centralized policy checks help maintenance, but copied workflows and destructive side effects hidden behind an assertion name make future changes harder to own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked duplicates unlinkAccount's local field reset; extract a shared local unlink operation so takeover can reuse it without provider cleanup.

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicated linking, downloading and unlinking blocks are direct copies rather than logic concealed through restructuring.

abstraction_drift.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked gains the replaceExistingLink parameter, closed-target rejection and replacement-unlink branches, evolving from validation into mutation; all six link handlers call it.
